name: Poop on your Phone
subtitle: Free games. Never any ads.
description:
We all poop. We all go on our phone. Play these games instead of brainrotting. Never any ads.

Play Crossword, Word Guess Daily, and Galactic Raiders — or create your own game. Describe an idea and turn it into a playable 2D or 3D game. Ask for changes, save your favorites, and play them from your dashboard. Three.js games are supported.

The three built-in games work offline. Game creation requires an internet connection and Sign in with Apple. New accounts receive 10 free creation credits; each successful creation or revision uses one credit. There are no purchases or subscriptions. Your created games are private to your account.
reviewNotes: The dashboard includes three bundled offline games and a private AI game authoring tool. Built-in games require no sign-in. To test creation: tap Create a game, use Sign in with Apple, enter a prompt (for example: Create a touch-controlled 3D cube collecting game), tap Create, and accept the explicit Anthropic data-sharing consent. Each new Apple account receives 10 free credits. A successful creation or revision costs 1 credit; failures are refunded. Play the result, save it to the dashboard, and request changes in the studio. HTML/CSS/JavaScript and Three.js run in an isolated web player with no native app credentials. Prompts and existing game code are sent to Anthropic only after consent; accounts, code, and credits are stored in Supabase. Users can withdraw AI permission, sign out, and delete their account and cloud games in the studio. Generated games are private: no public catalog, sharing, messaging, or other users content. No advertising, tracking, purchases, or subscriptions. Reviewers may use their own Apple account; there is no password login. Privacy/support is linked from the dashboard and studio.
